description: This file is a shell script dedicated to testing Git behavior regarding CRLF sequences, file modifications, and diff outputs. It sets up test cases to verify that CR in CRLF sequences is ignored during similarity analysis, using commands like git diff, git add, and git commit.

methods.name: append_cr
methods.description: A function (presumably defined in the sourced test-lib.sh) that appends a CR (Carriage Return) character to input data to simulate CRLF sequences.

methods.name: test_tick
methods.description: A function to introduce a delay or mark a point in test execution, defined in the test-lib.sh.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: A function to compare expected output with actual output, defined in the test-lib.sh.
